verses.text: Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to Your name be the glory, because of Your loving devotion, because of Your faithfulness.

xrefs.text: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of Your name; deliver us and atone for our sins, for the sake of Your name.
For My own sake, My very own sake, I will act; for how can I let Myself be defamed? I will not yield My glory to another.
Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; bring an offering and enter His courts.
But I acted for the sake of My name, so that it would not be profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.
It is not for your sake that I will act, declares the Lord GOD— let it be known to you. Be ashamed and disgraced for your ways, O house of Israel!

verses.text: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?”

xrefs.text: My tears have been my food both day and night, while men ask me all day long, “Where is your God?”
Why should the nations ask, “Where is their God?” Before our eyes, make known among the nations Your vengeance for the bloodshed of Your servants.
Like the crushing of my bones, my enemies taunt me, while they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”

Why should the Egyptians declare, ‘He brought them out with evil intent, to kill them in the mountains and wipe them from the face of the earth’? Turn from Your fierce anger and relent from doing harm to Your people.
If You kill this people as one man, the nations who have heard of Your fame will say,

verses.text: Our God is in heaven; He does as He pleases.

xrefs.text: The LORD does all that pleases Him in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and in all their depths.

All the peoples of the earth are counted as nothing, and He does as He pleases with the army of heaven and the peoples of the earth. There is no one who can restrain His hand or say to Him, ‘What have You done?’”
I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times what is still to come. I say, ‘My purpose will stand, and all My good pleasure I will accomplish.’
In Him we were also chosen as God’s own, having been predestined according to the plan of Him who works out everything by the counsel of His will,
The LORD has established His throne in heaven, and His kingdom rules over all.

verses.text: Their idols are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.

xrefs.text: And there you will serve man-made gods of wood and stone, which cannot see or hear or eat or smell.
They pour out their bags of gold and weigh out silver on scales; they hire a goldsmith to fashion it into a god, so they can bow down and worship.
For the customs of the peoples are worthless; they cut down a tree from the forest; it is shaped with a chisel by the hands of a craftsman.
To an idol that a craftsman casts and a metalworker overlays with gold and fits with silver chains?
What use is an idol, that a craftsman should carve it— or an image, a teacher of lies? For its maker trusts in his own creation; he makes idols that cannot speak.

verses.text: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;

xrefs.text: Like scarecrows in a cucumber patch, their idols cannot speak. They must be carried because they cannot walk. Do not fear them, for they can do no harm, and neither can they do any good.”

verses.text: they have ears, but cannot hear; they have noses, but cannot smell;
they have hands, but cannot feel; they have feet, but cannot walk; they cannot even clear their throats.
Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.

xrefs.text: Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.
What use is an idol, that a craftsman should carve it— or an image, a teacher of lies? For its maker trusts in his own creation; he makes idols that cannot speak.
But they are altogether senseless and foolish, instructed by worthless idols made of wood!
Those who cling to worthless idols forsake His loving devotion.
All makers of idols are nothing, and the things they treasure are worthless. Their witnesses fail to see or comprehend, so they are put to shame.

verses.text: O Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.

xrefs.text: Trust in Him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts before Him. God is our refuge. Selah
Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness.
Every word of God is flawless; He is a shield to those who take refuge in Him.
Let Israel say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
O house of Israel, bless the LORD; O house of Aaron, bless the LORD;

verses.text: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.

xrefs.text: Let the house of Aaron say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
[“]Next, have your brother Aaron brought to you from among the Israelites, along with his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, to serve Me as priests.

Then he said to Korah and all his followers, “Tomorrow morning the LORD will reveal who belongs to Him and who is holy, and He will bring that person near to Himself. The one He chooses He will bring near to Himself.

just as the LORD commanded him through Moses. This was to be a reminder to the Israelites that no outsider who is not a descendant of Aaron should approach to offer incense before the LORD, lest he become like Korah and his followers.

But only you and your sons shall attend to your priesthood for everything concerning the altar and what is inside the veil, and you are to perform that service. I am giving you the work of the priesthood as a gift, but any outsider who comes near the sanctuary must be put to death.”

verses.text: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.

xrefs.text: He who fears the LORD is secure in confidence, and his children shall have a place of refuge.
but welcomes those from every nation who fear Him and do what is right.
The LORD is pleased with those who fear Him, who hope in His loving devotion.
Every word of God is flawless; He is a shield to those who take refuge in Him.
Then a voice came from the throne, saying: “Praise our God, all you who serve Him, and those who fear Him, small and great alike!

verses.text: The LORD is mindful of us; He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron;

xrefs.text: He remembered us in our low estate His loving devotion endures forever.
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly realms.
Remember these things, O Jacob, for you are My servant, O Israel. I have made you, and you are My servant; O Israel, I will never forget you.
I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great, so that you will be a blessing.
But Zion said, “The LORD has forsaken me; the Lord has forgotten me!”

verses.text: He will bless those who fear the LORD— small and great alike.

xrefs.text: Hallelujah! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who greatly delights in His commandments.
A song of ascents. Blessed are all who fear the LORD, who walk in His ways!
His mercy extends to those who fear Him, from generation to generation.
Then a voice came from the throne, saying: “Praise our God, all you who serve Him, and those who fear Him, small and great alike!
The LORD gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with peace.

verses.text: May the LORD give you increase, both you and your children.

xrefs.text: May the LORD, the God of your fathers, increase you a thousand times over and bless you as He has promised.
This promise belongs to you and your children and to all who are far off— to all whom the Lord our God will call to Himself.
And you are sons of the prophets and of the covenant God made with your fathers when He said to Abraham, ‘Through your offspring all the families of the earth will be blessed.’
As the hosts of heaven cannot be counted and as the sand on the seashore cannot be measured, so too will I multiply the descendants of My servant David and the Levites who minister before Me.”
I will establish My covenant as an everlasting covenant between Me and you and your descendants after you, to be your God and the God of your descendants after you.

verses.text: May you be blessed by the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.

xrefs.text: May the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.
And he said in a loud voice, “Fear God and give Him glory, because the hour of His judgment has come. Worship the One who made the heavens and the earth and the sea and the springs of waters.
In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
and he blessed Abram and said: “Blessed be Abram by God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth,
My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.

verses.text: The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but the earth He has given to mankind.

xrefs.text: You made him ruler of the works of Your hands; You have placed everything under his feet:
The heavens are Yours, and also the earth. The earth and its fullness You founded.
God blessed them and said to them, “Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth and subdue it; rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air and every creature that crawls upon the earth.”
By My great power and outstretched arm, I made the earth and the men and beasts on the face of it, and I give it to whom I please.
And God blessed Noah and his sons and said to them, “Be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth.

verses.text: It is not the dead who praise the LORD, nor any who descend into silence.

xrefs.text: For there is no mention of You in death; who can praise You from Sheol?
For Sheol cannot thank You; Death cannot praise You. Those who descend to the Pit cannot hope for Your faithfulness.
Do You work wonders for the dead? Do departed spirits rise up to praise You? Selah
“What gain is there in my bloodshed, in my descent to the Pit? Will the dust praise You? Will it proclaim Your faithfulness?
O LORD, let me not be ashamed, for I have called on You. Let the wicked be put to shame; let them lie silent in Sheol.

verses.text: But it is we who will bless the LORD, both now and forevermore. Hallelujah!

xrefs.text: Blessed be the name of the LORD both now and forevermore.
and declared: “Blessed be the name of God forever and ever, for wisdom and power belong to Him.
My mouth will declare the praise of the LORD; let every creature bless His holy name forever and ever.

And I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea, and all that is in them, saying: “To Him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be praise and honor and glory and power forever and ever!
Every day I will bless You, and I will praise Your name forever and ever.
